[LCON.4.4.3] Call provenance ([RFCS.15]): when provenance
recording is enabled, outbound calls persist as `CallIssued` atoms
that are compared, never injected. Pass criteria: stripping
every `CallIssued` atom leaves replay bit-identical; corrupting a
`CallIssued` field is flagged as the effect Divergence at that `seq`
([LFST.9.3.6]).
